question: Could you provide the annual percentage shares, rounded to two decimal places, of the top 5 minor crime categories from 2008 in London's total crimes, with each year displayed in one row?
sql:
WITH top5_2008 AS (
  SELECT minor_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  WHERE year = 2008
  GROUP BY minor_category
  ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
annual_totals AS (
  SELECT year, SUM(value) as total_crimes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  GROUP BY year
),
category_yearly AS (
  SELECT 
    c.year,
    c.minor_category,
    SUM(c.value) as category_crimes,
    a.total_crimes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa` c
  JOIN annual_totals a ON c.year = a.year
  WHERE c.minor_category IN (SELECT minor_category FROM top5_2008)
  GROUP BY c.year, c.minor_category, a.total_crimes
)
SELECT 
  year,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Other Theft' THEN category_crimes END), MAX(total_crimes)) * 100, 2) AS other_theft_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Theft From Motor Vehicle' THEN category_crimes END), MAX(total_crimes)) * 100, 2) AS theft_from_motor_vehicle_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Possession Of Drugs' THEN category_crimes END), MAX(total_crimes)) * 100, 2) AS possession_of_drugs_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Burglary in a Dwelling' THEN category_crimes END), MAX(total_crimes)) * 100, 2) AS burglary_in_dwelling_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Assault with Injury' THEN category_crimes END), MAX(total_crimes)) * 100, 2) AS assault_with_injury_pct
FROM category_yearly
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
